summary: Bug-fix verification for 'blank white screen after login' on the per-environment backend (https://stock-tracker-2199.preview.emergentagent.com). RESULT: BUG IS FIXED. Admin login lands on a fully-rendered Dashboard (no blank page, no ErrorBoundary fallback). All 10 KPI cards render with numeric values: kpi-total_items=12, kpi-units_available=976, kpi-units_out=1, kpi-total_units=977, kpi-warehouses=2, kpi-units_damaged=1, kpi-units_lost=1, kpi-units_used=2, kpi-sj_active=0, kpi-sj_returned=1. 'Surat Jalan Terbaru' section renders 1 entry (SJ-202608-0001, Selesai) — not empty and not crashed — proving the schema-tolerant norm.recent = recent_sj ?? recent_surat_jalan ?? [] guard works. error-reload-btn is NOT present (ErrorBoundary not triggered). Regression checks all pass: Inventory shows 12 rows with colored brand dots + brand name + jenis + gudang; admin sees add-item-btn and export-xlsx-btn. Surat Jalan tab-aktif and tab-selesai both present and clickable. Penerimaan page shows create-penerimaan-btn. Master Data sidebar links (gudang/brand/jenis/pengguna) visible for admin. Staff login: KPI cards still render (dashboard fix confirmed for staff too), and Master Data links + add-item-btn + export-xlsx-btn are correctly hidden.

issues: Native browser date input still used (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar Popover — cosmetic only, unchanged from prior iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx norm object correctly tolerates both English (v3.0) and Indonesian schema keys and guards recent_sj/recent_surat_jalan with ?? []. This is the exact fix needed for the reported blank-screen crash.
ErrorBoundary is wired in App.js and would surface error-reload-btn if a render still crashed — verified NOT triggered in this run.
api.js uses REACT_APP_API_URL || REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, currently resolved to the per-env backend at stock-tracker-2199, which is online and serving data.
Sidebar testids remain Indonesian-derived (sidebar-inventori-link, sidebar-surat-jalan-link, sidebar-gudang-link, etc.). Consider making testids i18n-independent for stability.

rca of the issue: Original bug: dashboard crashed on d.recent_sj.length when backend returned recent_surat_jalan (Indonesian schema), causing blank-white-screen. FIX (verified): (1) Dashboard.jsx normalises both schemas via nullish coalescing on every KPI key and recent list; (2) ErrorBoundary wraps routes as a safety net; (3) api base uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to point at a live per-env backend. All three verified working.
